scope: Read-only source/contract ordering review of four host stages, three Core stages, fourteen world dispatch segments and two distinct automatic controller branches. This is not full HC acceptance, transitive purity proof, implementation review or executed evidence.

checks.facts: Actual Submit captures under gate, selects SeatCommandGrant before actor control and kind gate, then applies the original all-profile exact Companion Haven offers and pre-Bishop milestone override. The new read must share those two selection positions, not widen all catalog grants or copy legacy QueryCasting omissions.

Host shape/payload precedes principal+Id receipt conflict; exact matching retry skips ExpectedRevision/KnownTarget only at this layer. The actual single Simulation.Execute still checks current Core authority/inventory before its duplicate lookup. Receipt classification internal to the prefix does not authorize its public disclosure.

Operator Hero plus exact Clock/Close grants and explicit defender owner/grant/profile/kind routes remain distinct. EndFixedEncounter current-turn target predicate applies only on the fresh host path. No seat DTO can create these grants.

KnownTarget remains branch-specific and fresh-only. Its existing condition-dependent branches cannot be called by a new read without the matching explicit condition context. Identity-known is not current native usability or general discovery authority.

Native shape, payload and actor/world/clock/controller checks precede current inventory claims. RequiredInventoryOwners remains native policy claims rather than inferred custody or actor control. No source-wide snapshot validation is part of this preflight contract. Full transitive helper closure is separately still required.

ValidateCommandAndAuthority precedes Core receipt identity and fingerprint, then fresh ExpectedRevision, actor existence and revision/receipt capacity. Duplicate does not reacquire fresh family eligibility. Current inventory revocation can deny an exact duplicate.

One candidate transaction runs resolution, rejects failure/schema changes, attaches next revision/receipt, rejects clock reversal, validates candidate/checkpoint, then copies and publishes state/checkpoint. Detail collection must observe the actual transaction and cannot cause another Execute/assessment or alter commit on projection failure.
Actor, Ferry Dash/off-calendar Seal, Long Rest dispatch and active-rest exclusion retain their original earliest ordering.
Early Sanctuary pending response and attack-gate branches remain before Guidance/casting/general combat. New reads must use immutable pending-response context, not current copied resolvers.

Guidance, contamination, casting, utility/repertoire, Cleric short-rest denial and six magic/rest dispatches retain return positions. Existing assessTactical is not proof of these family paths being pure.
Decay/wound and participant exclusions precede ordinary Search/Hide conflict/control dispatch.
Retreat, preservation transition, camp/recovery choice and recovery/debt/morale/care/rest conflicts retain ordering.
Service and reinforcement/stabilization/charter/plan/bill/sale/meal dispatch precedes meal-serving and whole-tender restrictions.
Camp/routes, fractional stationary restrictions and moving route exclusion precede observation action dispatch.
Trap handover and blood handling precede off-calendar work, Overwatch, advancement/periodic, manifest and pending-manufacturing restrictions, assignments, Seal and excavation.

Portable preservation precondition and controlled opening bookkeeping retain their special branch; mining/manufacturing/trap/cache/repair/formula dispatches retain native order. Do not execute these resolvers on a copy for new reads.
Encounter entry can interrupt active Haven care in the actual transaction; tactical pressure bookkeeping stays execution-only. Outside-combat denials and actual clock payload guard precede AdvanceTo.
Traversal facts assessment precedes actual encounter transition, run/Dash payment, detach, edge/charter updates; pause/resume retains its own payment and reconciliation stages.

Nonadmitted condition event remains execution-only; generic Move/Interact fallback precedes management membership and stationary/capability/two-hands checks. Earlier Interact branches remain eligible only as originally dispatched.
Concurrent traversal and ordered one-second deadline exclusions remain ahead of handling; rich preview cannot reorder rejection or compute future lifecycle outcomes.

Filling assessment branch precedes actual inventory/vessel resolver, preservation opening evidence and handling time credit. Native post-resolution settlement/condition/activity refresh stays execution-only.

HasGrant and decision owner precede no-primary Waiting. Inside delivery lock, internal DefenderAuthority is selected. Primary admitted/duplicate executes once. A stale primary permits fallback duplicate lookup only. RuleDenied+MayFallback can assess/execute fallback and returns fallback denial/status if not executed. RuleDenial may produce Waiting after a real assessed candidate but no authoritative execution.

Uses incoming creature grant. Fallback considered on stale primary or eligible RuleDenied. Execute fallback only on duplicate or first RuleDenied plus second admitted. Otherwise final status comes from first assessment even if second was examined. Do not reuse LaterDefender internal authority or terminal-status policy.

freshnessDisposition.status: eligible proposed additive ordering; actual GPT/full HC approval remains separate
freshnessDisposition.rule: A new expectedObservationRevision check after original host current-grant/control/kind/payload checks and before internal receipt/fresh target/Core preflight does not alter legacy Submit because Submit gains no observation argument/check. A stale read must not disclose receipt/outcome facts. Any later authorized receipt metadata requires current Core actor/inventory and exact selected grant, even if the host internally classified the receipt earlier.
legacyInvariants: Core current inventory authority remains before Core duplicate recognition.
Exact duplicate retains its original ExpectedRevision and fresh KnownTarget bypass.
Current observation revision is never substituted into the command.

sanctuaryDisposition.status: proposed replacement consistent with controlling contract; existing helper not approved for pure reuse
sourceFacts: SharedSanctuary.cs:105-108 derives actual original attack or Opportunity continuation Command.
SharedSanctuary.cs:115-116 mutates copied admission with FinishSanctuary then resolves continuation.
sanctuaryDisposition.requiredInterpretation: The prohibition on a hypothetical completed gate/retarget candidate forbids a mutated hypothetical Snapshot or predictive resolution; it must not drop the original attack payload and legal continuation facts. Immutable pending-response context must represent the actual admitted original source and assess its authorized continuation without calling FinishSanctuary, ResolveCore or rolling.
sanctuaryDisposition.nativeRestrictionsRetained: Opportunity retarget denial, supported original attack source, failed target, actual attacker interval and their native order remain required. Conditional later roll/effects remain separate from initial eligibility.
sanctuaryDisposition.alreadyExplicitElsewhere: SOURCE_API_CONTRACT.md pure Sanctuary requirement and PURE_ASSESSMENT_AUDIT.md Sanctuary row already supply this constraint; no amendment is required solely for the abbreviated outer-plan wording.

remainingLimits: The plan itself leaves selected capacity/spatial/speed/deadline helper closure and all-profile copy inputs open; this review does not close them.
No source operation was treated as pure merely because state was copied, RNG remained unchanged, or an assess flag was supplied.
RequiredInventoryOwners direct source was reviewed through line182; this is not a new complete transitive property/helper audit for all unsupported policy families.
No prospective checks, branch profiles, five paths, no-mutation instrumentation or compilation were executed.

Actual primary/fallback assessments, terminal candidate and executed candidate must be recorded separately from the same authoritative transaction; current API availability is not implementation evidence.
No original source rule, prior acceptance, save/root/schema or gameplay authority was changed.
